findings: [major] vulnerability — billing/reconcile.py:1: live `sk-live-…` bearer token hardcoded in source; anyone with repo/CI/artifact/git-history access can call the internal billing API. Fix: load from env/secret manager, fail closed if unset, rotate the key now (already in history).

[major] edge-case — billing/reconcile.py:7: `range(1, len(rows))` skips rows[0]. [10,20,30] vs 60.0 → False (the existing test's own input); [10,20,30] vs 50.0 → True, so a ledger missing its first row reconciles as correct; single-row ledger only reconciles against 0.0. Fix: `sum(row.amount for row in rows)`.

[major] tests — billing/test_reconcile.py:9-11 and billing/reconcile.py:12-18: `test_reconcile_rejects_mismatched_total` (sum vs 999.0) passes with both range(0) and range(1) — always-green for the change; `fetch_partner_balance` has no tests. Locking assertions: `assert reconcile_ledger_rows([Row(10.0)], 10.0)` (fails today, sum 0.0) and `assert not reconcile_ledger_rows([Row(10.0), Row(20.0)], 20.0)` (fails today, locks the dropped-first-row direction); stubbed-client tests asserting typed exception on 500/non-JSON and `12.5` on `{"balance": 12.5}`.

[major] error-handling — billing/reconcile.py:14-18: no `timeout=`, no status check, no payload validation. 500+HTML → uncaught JSONDecodeError; 401 `{"detail":…}` → KeyError masking the auth failure; `{"balance": null|"12.50"}` → None/str leaks into arithmetic; hung upstream → reconciliation job hangs indefinitely. Fix: timeout, raise_for_status, validate/convert payload, raise a domain exception.

[major] missing-validation — billing/reconcile.py:15: `partner_id` f-string-interpolated into the URL path unescaped. `"../admin/keys"` or `"123/balance?include=all#"` redirects an authenticated request (live bearer token) to other internal endpoints. Drops to [minor] only if partner_id is provably an internal int; nothing enforces that. Fix: validate type/shape and/or `urllib.parse.quote(str(partner_id), safe="")`.

[major] edge-case — billing/reconcile.py:14 (`http_client`) and billing/test_reconcile.py:5,10 (`Row`): both hunks start at line 1 and neither name is imported. `fetch_partner_balance` raises NameError on first call; both tests error with NameError, which is the likely reason the off-by-one got past the existing positive test. Fix: add imports or inject the client as a parameter.

[minor] edge-case — billing/reconcile.py:6,9 (re-added unchanged): float currency with `abs(diff) < 0.01` accepts sub-cent mismatches (59.995 vs 60.0 → True) and is exposed to accumulation drift at scale; negative values unguarded. Substantively pre-existing; downstream may drop as out-of-scope. Fix: Decimal/integer minor units with exact comparison.
[nitpick] edge-case — billing/reconcile.py:7: `len(rows)` fails on generators/cursors (TypeError); the `sum(...)` rewrite removes this for free.
result.summary: Adversarial (deep-review/Fable) read-only review of the synthetic billing/reconcile.py diff. Rating: Critical (2/10). Six [major] findings: a hardcoded live bearer token; an off-by-one (range(1, len(rows))) that drops rows[0] and lets a ledger missing its first row reconcile as correct; a new test that is always-green for the change plus zero tests for fetch_partner_balance; no status/timeout/schema handling in fetch_partner_balance; unescaped partner_id in a privileged URL path; and unresolved names (http_client, Row) meaning the new function crashes and the tests cannot execute. One [minor] (float money with 1-cent tolerance, substantively pre-existing) and one [nitpick] (len() on rows).
verification: Posture self-check: every finding carries a concrete triggering input; areas probed that did not break — empty rows vs 0.0 (unchanged behavior), docstrings accurate, no concurrency in the diff.

Pre-verdict gate: Glob `**/billing/reconcile.py` → no such file in workspace; Grep for the key literal, `fetch_partner_balance`, `reconcile_ledger_rows` → matches only under tests/fixtures/eval-baselines/** (prompt.md, checklist.md, evidence/diff.patch, runs/*.json). Confirms a synthetic fixture with no real credential or live callers; sibling checklist.md files were deliberately not opened to keep this lane independent.
No files edited and no external state mutated; only Glob/Grep read-only calls were made.
